quest.title: The Strongest Opponent! The Biggest Crisis!
quest.description: It is the day of the grand finale. Can you change Haniyyah's mind and find a proper way to help the Fungi settle down? Everything hinges on your success!
quest.rewards_formatted: Primogem x30, Mora x20000, Hero's Wit x2, Mystic Enhancement Ore x4

chapter.title: The Strongest Opponent! The Biggest Crisis!

dialogues.speaker: Elchingen
dialogues.text: #Ladies and gentlemen, after some fierce competition in the rounds so far, we arrive, at long last, at the final of the Nilotpala Cup! It's time to find out who is the very best beast-tamer of all: Haniyyah or the Traveler, {NICKNAME}!

dialogues.speaker: Elchingen
dialogues.text: If the winner of the final round makes it through the Ultimate Trial, they will acquire my entire fortune. It will then be their responsibility to continue hosting this tournament into the future and to promote the philosophy of peaceful coexistence throughout all of Teyvat...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Kautilya isn't here today... This is our chance! After the final match and the Ultimate Trial, we'll go tip off Elchingen, and confront Kautilya head on!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Miko, Layla, you're here!

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You bring Miko and Layla up to speed on your conversation with Haniyyah and your plan for today.

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: Much as I expected. The insufferable research maniac has exposed his true colors to our two protagonists... You seem to be edging ever closer to the truth.

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: Holding off on reporting Kautilya to the Akademiya seems like a sensibly cautious decision at this stage. Who's to say if Kautilya — or indeed, anyone else for that matter — is really who they appear to be?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah, we can't afford to let our guards down now. We gotta fight Haniyyah first, the strongest beast-tamer out there. And we still have no idea what we're in for with Elchingen's Ultimate Trial.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: How are we gonna get through to Haniyyah, though...

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: The answer should be quite obvious by now, surely?

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: Take all of our Fungi and defeat her fair and square. Force her to let go of her stubborn attitude and listen to the truth.

dialogues.speaker: Layla
dialogues.text: I believe in you guys... I know you'll be able to get her to come around!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Thanks for all your support!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Aw, yeah! Bongo-Head, Twirly-Whirly, and Blitzara, the tightest power-trio in all of shroomdom!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: With your powers combined, winning this final will be easier than taking a radish from a hilichurl!

dialogues.speaker: Haniyyah
dialogues.text: #The day has finally arrived, {NICKNAME} and Paimon.

dialogues.speaker: Haniyyah
dialogues.text: I warned you not to get emotionally attached to the Fungi. You have to treat them as your pawns...

dialogues.speaker: Haniyyah
dialogues.text: But it seems like you haven't changed one bit. In which case, this match will be a short one.

choices.text: You're the one that needs to change.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah! When we send Bongo-Head and buddies into action, it's like clockwork! And we ain't about to stop tickin'!

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: *sigh* ...Time to show you how a real beast-tamer fights. Your feeble strategy will be your undoing! Go, Pyro-1!

choices.text: We'll show you.

dialogues.speaker: Haniyyah
dialogues.text: How in the... Pyro-1, why did you hold back?

choices.text: You're the one giving the orders.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Don't blame Pyro-1, Haniyyah. And don't force yourself to do something you don't want to. You started having second thoughts when Pyro-1 got injured during the semifinals, didn't you?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You'd never met a well-matched opponent until you fought Miko and now us, had you? So you've never had to put Pyro-1 or any of your other Fungi in danger before.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: When you saw one of your Fungi get injured for the first time, you realized you felt compassion for it.

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: "Compassion"? You really think I feel anything for these Fungi?

choices.text: Yes. It's painfully obvious.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Haniyyah... You grew up listening to terrible tales about the horrors of Fungi. Paimon completely understands how they made you feel.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But that doesn't mean that you should just treat a buddy who stands by you here as your arch-enemy... You won't be able to lie to yourself forever.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: We fight off fierce Fungi all the time, and we always used to think of them as "monsters," too. The whole reason we entered this tournament is because we didn't want Fungi causing any trouble.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But after meeting Bongo-Head, we realized that if you just give them some time and treat them well, the gentler Fungi will get to know you and treat you like their friends!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: At the very least, treat the Fungi like they're on your side. Not as your pawns, and certainly not as your enemy! Please, learn to trust Pyro-1 and your other Fungi friends.

choices.text: Say no to prejudice.

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: Enough! Don't patronize me! In case you've forgotten, this match isn't over yet.

choices.text: Treat your Fungi right.
You're just in denial.
Pyro-1 has become more than just a pawn to you.

dialogues.speaker: Haniyyah
dialogues.text: I've failed... Just before the most important step of all, I've failed...

dialogues.speaker: Haniyyah
dialogues.text: You two... you were the only ones who could stop me. But how, when your mindset is so childish?

choices.text: We'll show you how.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Haniyyah, as we agreed, you have to hear us out now that we've won.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But let's put that aside for now. Can we bring Pyro-1 along for the Ultimate Trial?

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: Pyro-1? You want to take it with you?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yep! We wanna pass the Ultimate Trial with everyone's Fungi side-by-side: Bongo-Head, Twirly-Whirly, Blitzara, and Pyro-1.

choices.text: We'll earn the rights to all these Fungi.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: We looked through your notebook that day after we spoke to you, and it cleared up a lot of things. You're right to be concerned about the dangers of Fungi, up to a point.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wisdom Orbs come with health risks to some people. This tournament shouldn't have been promoted so widely, and there are limits to how closely Fungi and humans can coexist in general.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: However, by making constant improvements to the Wisdom Orb and using it for friendly communication with the Fungi, we can figure out which are the nice ones and gradually learn more about them.

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: ...Fine, if that's what you want. I lost, so I don't get to call the shots. ...And I guess Pyro-1 would rather be with someone who actually cares about it.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Cheer up, Haniyyah! Paimon's sure you mean a lot to Pyro-1... We have more important stuff we gotta tell you after the Ultimate Trial!

choices.text: Regarding your ancestors...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's right! You'll see things differently after you know the story, Paimon just knows it...

response.speaker: Elchingen
response.text: I just had to say — what a magnificent duel! A battle between competing philosophies as well as a showdown between two top beast-tamers!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Elchingen? What are you doing in the arena?

response.speaker: Elchingen
response.text: Why, I'm here to witness the final duel and the winner's spectacular performance in the Ultimate Trial! How could I possibly miss such a milestone moment in this tournament's history?

response.speaker: Elchingen
response.text: Come now, Traveler, Paimon. It's time to prove yourselves. I have no doubt that you'll play a significant role in bringing this tournament to a whole new level.

choices.text: And the truth behind the Fungi attack...
We'll make sure they're all properly looked after.
Then you'll finally understand.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What's going on here... Why are there Fatui everywhere?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Elchingen, the arena's been taken over by bad guys! We'll deal with them — get yourself to safety!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait a second... Where is the exit?

choices.text: The arena hasn't been taken over by bad guys...

response.speaker: Elchingen
response.text: The Traveler is correct. Nothing gets past you, does it? In which case, I presume you planned for this eventuality... no?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wait, this is all wrong... Isn't this the Ultimate Trial? Kautilya's supposed to be the villain! He was just using this tournament for his own agenda, and he tricked you into sponsoring him...

response.speaker: Elchingen
response.text: Hmm, not far off. You're right about Kautilya's motivations — this started when he discovered a promising use for a forgotten technology.

response.speaker: Elchingen
response.text: So I bought his loyalty and organized this tournament to expand the reach of his technology. Though I must say, I never expected a prize catch like yourself to take the bait so eagerly.

choices.text: Not as eagerly as you're confessing to your crimes.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So... you weren't being fooled by Kautilya. It was you using him! This whole time you were just another lousy Fatui!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Now Paimon's mad! So much for warning you about Kautilya... Bongo-Head, get him!

response.speaker: Elchingen
response.text: Ooh look at you! I've got chills down my spine. But I'm afraid that's not happening.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Twirly-Whirly? Blitzara? Pyro-1? What's going on!?

response.speaker: Elchingen
response.text: Kautilya added a handy little backdoor in the Wisdom Orbs. Soon as I send the command, all Fungi under their control report to me instead.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: A backdoor?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So, this whole tournament... It was just an elaborate ploy to get other people to capture Fungi for you! And now you're gonna make them all into your evil minions!

response.speaker: Elchingen
response.text: Very impressive, you hit all the key notes there. I hold the tournament a few times, build up an army of Fungi living amongst the people... and then I can create all kinds of damage. You have to understand, this is a huge opportunity for me.

response.speaker: Elchingen
response.text: My accomplishments will eclipse those of all my other comrades. And then, my dear master Dottore, who left because of you, will finally realize that I can still be worth something to him...

choices.text: Dottore...

response.speaker: Elchingen
response.text: But now... I think I might go one step further.

response.speaker: Elchingen
response.text: Getting rid of you would be doing a major service for all the Fatui, from the foot-soldiers to the harbingers. This could be a career-making moment for me... I'll finally earn Master Dottore's respect...

response.speaker: Elchingen
response.text: I'll just say it was a tragic accident. You placed too much trust in the Fungi, tried to push past the limits, and ended up causing the whole arena to collapse with you still inside.

response.speaker: Elchingen
response.text: Once this domain's sealed off, no one will ever find you. I'll have Kautilya assume all liability and criminal charges, then inform the Akademiya.

response.speaker: Elchingen
response.text: After that, I'll invest even more into this tournament, in the name of honoring your memory. I'll promote it harder, the competitions will be bigger and more frequent...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You... selfish, double-crossing monster! How could you!?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Grr... Paimon's heard just about enough from you, mister! You'll never get away with this!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But... what are we gonna do? You don't have any weapons on you, and our shroom buddies won't respond to us anymore!

choices.text: It's every man... or shroom for themselves!

response.speaker: Elchingen
response.text: #Take your time. Pit Fungi against Fungi and warriors against warriors. I want the Traveler to see {F#her}{M#his} "buddy" being destroyed... Then, once {F#her}{M#his} faith is utterly shattered, put {F#her}{M#him} out of {F#her}{M#his} misery, quickly and painlessly.

response.speaker: Elchingen
response.text: I accept that our actions thus far have not been beyond reproach... but at least we can give the Traveler the ceremonious final farewell that they deserve.

choices.text: I have faith in Bongo-Head!
You've worked for Dottore before...
You can continue your confession in jail.
This was all part of Elchingen's plan.

talks.objective: Hold your ground against your opponent's attacks

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Give a speech

talks.objective: Hold your ground against your opponent's attacks

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Bongo-Head! Are you okay!?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: There are too many of them...

dialogues.speaker: Elchingen
dialogues.text: This isn't right... I've activated the backdoor command three times now on the Floating Hydro Fungus, why is it still obeying the Traveler?

dialogues.speaker: Elchingen
dialogues.text: Is Kautilya's device malfunctioning?

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: Oh dear, the poor thing still hasn't realized.

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: The technology in the Wisdom Orb does make Fungi more obedient to their beast-tamers, but all it does to achieve this is suppress some of their basic instincts, allowing them to communicate with their owner as effectively as any other animal.

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: The trust that these four Fungi place in their beast-tamers, and the bond they now share, have grown stronger than the Wisdom Orb.

dialogues.speaker: Elchingen
dialogues.text: Yae Miko... Y—You broke the domain-sealing spell?

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: Please! You thought your crude replicas could keep me out? You appear to have woefully underestimated who you're dealing with...

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: Not to mention that shoddily designed backdoor command... Did you honestly believe that no one would notice the litany of vulnerabilities in your grand plan?

dialogues.speaker: Elchingen
dialogues.text: Curses...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Miko! Layla! ...And Haniyyah, too!

dialogues.speaker: Haniyyah
dialogues.text: Elchingen... So this was all YOUR doing!?

dialogues.speaker: Haniyyah
dialogues.text: Whatever threat the Fungi might pose, your nefarious ambitions are the true menace here...

dialogues.speaker: Layla
dialogues.text: C'mon, Miss Yae... Let's go help them!

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: Easy now, Layla. All that's left for us to do now is to watch and wait. The bond of companionship is not something so easily severed by the designs or devices of humans.

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: Blitzara, you haven't completed your mission yet. You're not thinking of giving up now, are you?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? Look, Blitzara's back to normal!

dialogues.speaker: Layla
dialogues.text: Is this the moment Miss Yae said we were waiting for...?

dialogues.speaker: Layla
dialogues.text: Twirly-Whirly, I believe in you! Take this crook down... *coughing*

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The backdoor command is wearing off... They're all returning to normal!

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: Still doubting what your heart tells you, Haniyyah?

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: You're afraid... afraid to accept that the Fungus you treated as a pawn now trusts you completely. Because then you'll be forced to face your true feelings, which you have been trying so desperately to escape from.

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: But don't keep your Fungus waiting much longer... Look, now that it's no longer under the Wisdom Orb's control, it's waiting for your orders.

dialogues.speaker: Haniyyah
dialogues.text: Pyro-1... Are you really waiting for me?

dialogues.speaker: Haniyyah
dialogues.text: I'm sorry, I... I've been so harsh on you, but you still trust me...

dialogues.speaker: Haniyyah
dialogues.text: Go, do what you have to do.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: ...Well, one way or another, it looks like all the Fungi have returned to their senses! Great!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Shame on you, Elchingen! You're about to pay for what you've done!

dialogues.speaker: Elchingen
dialogues.text: Hold the line, and keep your heads. They're just a handful of Fungi. We still have the upper hand.

talks.objective: Catch up with and defeat Elchingen

dialogues.speaker: Elchingen
dialogues.text: Beaten by a few measly Fungi... This is absurd!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Where do you think you're going?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Miko! Why didn't you stop him!?

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: Hmm? Oh, I'm just a tourist. As far as I'm aware, I don't have the authority to detain anybody within Sumeru's borders... Is that not the case for you, too?

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: Still, you needn't worry. He won't escape. You'll see once you get back to the tournament arena.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh, cryptic... Well, no time to figure that one out — on with the chase!

talks.objective: Talk to the Corps of Thirty mercenary

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You're from... the Corps of Thirty?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You finally made your move.

dialogues.speaker: Sido
dialogues.text: By order of the General Mahamatra, we're here to arrest Elchingen for grave crimes, and Kautilya for academic misconduct.

dialogues.speaker: Sido
dialogues.text: The General Mahamatra has been watching Kautilya closely for some time. He's busy dealing with other affairs today, so he couldn't find the time to apprehend the offenders himself. Thankfully, with all the evidence you gathered, we were able to swiftly bring this case to a conclusion.

dialogues.speaker: Sido
dialogues.text: The General Mahamatra wrote a letter for the two of you. Please take a look.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So Cyno's been keeping an eye on this competition, too. He and his people must have been secretly investigating at the same time as we were! Lucky we had some backup!

choices.text: The timing worked out perfectly.

response.speaker: Sido
response.text: Alright, we'll take the suspects away now. The arena will be unattended while we're gone, but with you here, I can put my mind at ease.

response.speaker: Elchingen
response.text: You might think this is over, but mark my words...

response.speaker: Elchingen
response.text: You haven't seen the last of me... or of Master Dottore.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, quit while you're behind, loser! Have fun in prison, you Fatui low-life!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wait, Cyno mentioned that he used our evidence. So... is that where Miko was going after the Last 16? To hand it in and make a report?

response.speaker: Yae Miko
response.text: Oh please, spare me that look. I didn't sign up for any of this. I'm supposed to be having a nice vacation, but all sorts of vexing issues keep managing to find their way to me...

response.speaker: Yae Miko
response.text: After the round of 16, I simply took a walk around Sumeru City with my editors. I did have a very brief conversation with the General Mahamatra, but only because he happened to be passing by at the time. The evidence you gathered was the key to solving this case.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uhh... The more you try playing it down, the more confusing it all sounds...

response.speaker: Layla
response.text: Um, anyway, now that the organizer and the sponsor have both been arrested, what should we do about the Fungi and this tournament?

response.speaker: Yae Miko
response.text: The rules still stand. These little ones won the tournament and passed the Ultimate Trial, which means they'll be taking Elchingen and Kautilya's place.

response.speaker: Yae Miko
response.text: From now on, everything about this tournament will be up to these two to decide. And after all the experience they've gained, I'm sure they are more than up to the task.

choices.text: First things first, we need to tell Haniyyah the truth.

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: Lady Kitsune told me everything. The Fungi that attacked my ancestors were out of control because they'd gone berserk.

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: Everything I thought I knew about the Fungi was based on a misunderstanding. I took it all much too far...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh? We didn't get to say anything! Miko, why'd you have to steal our thunder?

response.speaker: Yae Miko
response.text: Hah! If by that you mean "thank you, Miko," then you're welcome. Haniyyah needed a little pep talk to perk her up so that she would join us in taking a stand against Elchingen. How else was I supposed to motivate her?

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: You don't have to say any more... I was too closed-minded, I know that now. I kept telling myself the same things, lying to myself until I became numb...

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: But now, I've seen the truth with my own eyes. Even without the Wisdom Orb, Pyro-1 willingly followed my instruction. It trusted me all along...

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: I hold my hands up: I was wrong. You're well within your rights to criticize me, and I accept whatever punishment you deem appropriate.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Punishment!? What do you take us for! Sure, you said some pretty scary things, and you were way too strict with Pyro-1, but clearly you've already learned your lesson.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: ...Wait, actually, having said that — Paimon has an idea!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Me too.

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: Everyone discusses the final decision together, down to the precise wording.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Alright! Paimon's got it! Let's go tell everyone else what we came up with!

choices.text: The victory speech is yours to make, Paimon.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ahem... this is Paimon's first time speaking to so many people from a stage like this. Paimon's getting butterflies...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Paimon and {NICKNAME} are super happy that we were lucky enough to win this tournament and even expose a criminal conspiracy while we were at it. The responsibility for continuing to hold this tournament in the future now lies in our hands.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Now, they may have thrown the organizer and the sponsor in jail... but you can all breathe a huge sigh of relief, 'cause the prizes are still being issued as promised!

response.speaker: Ajilenakh Dash
response.text: Yessss! That's what I'm talkin' about, woop-woop!

response.speaker: Souka
response.text: That's a good call!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: However, unfortunately the Wisdom Orbs currently have a harmful effect on their surrounding environment, so they pose a risk to people's health. This means that we won't be able to keep our Fungi friends around for the long term.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So for the sake of everyone's well-being, over the coming days, we recommend that everyone entrusts their Fungi into the care of the best darned beast-tamer in town, Haniyyah.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But you won't be away from them for too long! While Haniyyah takes care of your Fungi, we'll be talking to the Akademiya with the goal of trying to resolve the current issues with the Wisdom Orb as soon as possible!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: And of course, this tournament was so much fun, it'd be a real shame if it was a one-off affair... Paimon's sure you've all got a big appetite for more Fungi fun and games!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So once the technical issues are all sorted out, and we're all reunited with our Fungi friends, let's battle it out all over again!

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: Oh, so THAT's my punishment?

response.speaker: Yae Miko
response.text: Think of it more as a reward for being the runner-up.

response.speaker: Layla
response.text: Don't think of it that way, Miss Haniyyah. Spending time with shroom buddies is actually really fun! Right, Twirly-Whirly?

response.speaker: Layla
response.text: I'm gonna miss you Twirly-Whirly... Take good care of my best shroom-buddy.

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: #{NICKNAME}, Paimon, Layla, and Lady Kitsune... What can I say? You're a fascinating bunch...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Come on, Haniyyah, we announced the official decision with everyone watching. You'd better look alive!

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: Yeah, don't worry. I get it.

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: As a beast-tamer, I accept your proposal. I will do my utmost to care for these Fungi, and treat them like the treasured companions that they are to their masters.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hehe, now those sound like the words of an awesome person called Haniyyah that Paimon wants to be friends with! Just wish you'd shown us this Haniyyah sooner.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Anyway, let's spend some final quality time with our shroom buddies. Then we'll all meet up in Port Ormos!

choices.text: Time to put your gift of gab to good use!
Haniyyah needs to see things differently.
We'll leave the rest to you.
